text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened one day as Valentine's Day 
drew near—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —So pleeease! Help me out, Groove-san~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If that's all you had to say, you could've 
told me at the dorms. Why come all the way 
to the classroom...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was in a rush, and... well~ I wanted to 
see what you looked like in class, 
Groove-san♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... All right, after school 
then.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yay~, thank you, Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: W-Wah. Did you hear that just now...?
choice_data_list: If there's anything, I can help out too.
If there's anything, I can help out too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "No, I don't need it! It's not necessary!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Today's a day off from training, right? 
You don't need to come check on me, okay? 
Well then, bye!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I got rejected.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, Fine Motion began 
hurrying straight home the moment training 
finished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if I ask the captain of the guard—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but we are not 
involved in His Highness's private 
affairs...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. May I borrow some of your 
private time after school?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's a deal! Looking forward to 
it~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading to the designated spot after 
school...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chatter, chatter...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Happy Valentine's, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Hello. I've gone ahead and started eating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bodyguards were gathered around Fine 
Motion, having a meal together.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As a small token of my gratitude for 
everyone's daily consideration♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With Groove-san's help, I gave cooking a 
try~♪

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"I, too, was invited just a moment ago... 
Normally, dining as an equal alongside 
Your Highness would be unthinkable, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day today! Trainer, 
please have some too♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's really getting lively, isn't it? 
Helping out with the prep work was worth 
it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I brought what you asked for. Though... 
are you really going to use this?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~♪ Trainer, I'm rooting for you all 
the way~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A fan like the ones our supporters use! I 
thought it'd be perfect for showing my 
gratitude♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Big fan of Groove-san too! And a big fan 
of the Captain too~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ……Captain, I can only imagine your stress.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
No, it is no trouble at all... By the way, 
I would love to capture Your Highness's 
adorable appearance right now. May I take 
a photo?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Is everyone around Fine just 
completely soft on her?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~! Oshi~ LOVE~ Big on oshi, extra 
veggies please♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And one day, after finishing some errands 
and returning to the Trainer's room... I 
found a card resting on my desk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nothing else was written on it. However, 
only one person came to mind who would 
slip me such a card—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You found me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You know, there's something I want 
to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, let's just stick to the usual 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Surpri~se!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I bestow this upon you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Fine Motion handed me was a vibrant 
arrangement of preserved flowers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
With Groove-san's help, I tried making it 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She knows so much about flowers, so she 
helped me figure out which kinds to pick 
and how to care for them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I thought making it this shape would help 
it last longer♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you happy? Did you like it, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thought today would be a good 
opportunity to express my gratitude to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, I meant to prepare the 
right words to say, but..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The moment I saw your face... I felt like 
I was gonna say something weird, so I 
stopped!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I didn't say anything, so of course it's a 
secret!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I put everything into that gift. Will 
you take good care of it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. Please take care of it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So that my feelings may remain in full 
bloom forever—
